1.web: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,
1.asv: Then there come to Jesus from Jerusalem Pharisees and scribes, saying,

2.web: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
2.asv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

3.web: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?
3.asv: And he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?

4.web: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
4.asv: For God said, Honor thy father and thy mother: and, He that speaketh evil of father or mother, let him die the death.

5.web: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”
5.asv: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, That wherewith thou mightest have been profited by me is given to God;

6.web: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.
6.asv: he shall not honor his father. And ye have made void the word of God because of your tradition.

7.web: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
7.asv: Ye hypocrites, well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

8.web: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
8.asv: This people honoreth me with their lips; But their heart is far from me.

9.web: And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”
9.asv: But in vain do they worship me, Teachingas theirdoctrines the precepts of men.

10.web: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.
10.asv: And he called to him the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

11.web: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”
11.asv: Not that which entereth into the mouth defileth the man; but that which proceedeth out of the mouth, this defileth the man.

12.web: Then the disciples came, and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?”
12.asv: Then came the disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?

13.web: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
13.asv: But he answered and said, Every plant which my heavenly Father planted not, shall be rooted up.

14.web: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
14.asv: Let them alone: they are blind guides. And if the blind guide the blind, both shall fall into a pit.

15.web: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”
15.asv: And Peter answered and said unto him, Declare unto us the parable.

16.web: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?
16.asv: And he said, Are ye also even yet without understanding?

17.web: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?
17.asv: Perceive ye not, that whatsoever goeth into the mouth passeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

18.web: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.
18.asv: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come forth out of the heart; and they defile the man.

19.web: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
19.asv: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, railings:

20.web: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”
20.asv: these are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not the man.

21.web: Jesus went out from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
21.asv: And Jesus went out thence, and withdrew into the parts of Tyre and Sidon.

22.web: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”
22.asv: And behold, a Canaanitish woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a demon.

23.web: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”
23.asv: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

24.web: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
24.asv: But he answered and said, I was not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

25.web: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”
25.asv: But she came and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

26.web: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
26.asv: And he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread and cast it to the dogs.

27.web: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”
27.asv: But she said, Yea, Lord: for even the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.

28.web: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
28.asv: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it done unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was healed from that hour.

29.web: Jesus departed there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.
29.asv: And Jesus departed thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.

30.web: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,
30.asv: And there came unto him great multitudes, having with them the lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and they cast them down at his feet; and he healed them:

31.web: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, injured whole, lame walking, and blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.
31.asv: insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb speaking, the maimed whole, and the lame walking, and the blind seeing: and they glorified the God of Israel.

32.web: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
32.asv: And Jesus called unto him his disciples, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat: and I would not send them away fasting, lest haply they faint on the way.

33.web: The disciples said to him, “Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”
33.asv: And the disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so many loaves in a desert place as to fill so great a multitude?

34.web: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
34.asv: And Jesus said unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few small fishes.

35.web: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
35.asv: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

36.web: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.
36.asv: and he took the seven loaves and the fishes; and he gave thanks and brake, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

37.web: They all ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.
37.asv: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up that which remained over of the broken pieces, seven baskets full.

38.web: Those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.
38.asv: And they that did eat were four thousand men, besides women and children.

39.web: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.
39.asv: And he sent away the multitudes, and entered into the boat, and came into the borders of Magadan.
